dynamic_line: Boom!  Found it.  I think.  I'll upload the data.  Look, like I said befoah, maybe you go check this place out, but don' touch nothin'.  Negotiate somethin' with the intercom, yeah?

responses.text: Thanks, Pat!  If it's what I'm looking for, I guess I'll have to decide if I want to activate the transponder for Rubik, or come talk to the intercom about it.
